title: BGC-TFBS: web resource for predicted transcription factor binding sites in biosynthetic gene cluster families (source code)
description: Source code of the BGC-TFBS web resource (https://bgc-tfbs.kcl.ac.uk), which provides predicted transcription factor binding motifs, cluster-encoded regulator annotations and sequence similarity networks for biosynthetic gene cluster families. Predictions were generated with the Motif-Miner pipeline (https://github.com/sysbiomelab/Motif-Miner). The underlying data are archived separately under CC BY 4.0 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22766286). Version used in Matine et al., submitted to Nucleic Acids Research, 2026.
